messages:
Maria G: FYI escalated from Acme integration team — they hit a large burst of 503s from hosted inference starting ~09:12 UTC. Customer says calls are timing out and their app surface shows 503 → they suspect upstream restarts. Example call id: call_8c9a. Pasting the error snippets they collected below.

Maria G: customer logs:
```
[2024-06-18T09:11:53Z] inference-runner[pid=4721]: E libinference: CUDA error: out of memory at /work/kernel.cu:1223
[2024-06-18T09:11:54Z] inference-runner[pid=4721]: FATAL: Segmentation fault (core dumped)
[2024-06-18T09:11:54Z] supervisor: worker exited with status 139, restarting
```

ops-bot: Autoscaler: scale_event - pool=hosted-infer-prod, nodepool=gpu-v100, reason=oom-kill, delta=+2 at 2024-06-18T09:12:01Z :warning:

Kevin S: Oncall SRE — looking. Quick asks: what model/version, seq len, batch size, and are they using kv-prefetch or long context caching? Any client-side retries (that could amplify)?

Maria G: Model: gpt-8k-open (quantized int8), customer is using long-context Q&A, reported sequence length ~8000 tokens, max_new_tokens=2000, batch_size=4. They also enabled prefix KV prefetch on the client for some sessions. They say it was working last week until a deploy on Monday.

Anjali P: That config is heavy for a v100-like GPU. If the runtime switched kernel variant or introduced a prefetch path that keeps full KV on GPU, OOM is likely. Can someone pull pod GPU memory metrics and pod restart counts? run: `kubectl -n hosted logs -l app=inference-runner --since=15m --tail=200` and `kubectl top pod -n hosted`.

Ryan L: Runtime eng — I saw a similar stack when we rolled kernel_v2 last Monday. It only shows up with (int8 + kv_prefetch + >1k new tokens) due to an allocation loop we missed. Repro is straightforward on the harness. Will start a reproduce job now.

Sreeva N: Immediate mitigations: 1) route this customer's traffic to the smaller model variant (gpt-4k) 2) temporarily disable batching for their API key 3) put a short rate limit to avoid request amplification. I can push a routing override from Console.

Maria G: Customer asks for suggested changes they can apply while we work on a patch.

Ryan L: For customer-facing guidance: set max_new_tokens <= 512, set batch_size=1, and disable kv_prefetch. Example request snippet they can adopt: 
```
POST /v1/completions
{
  "model": "gpt-8k-open",
  "input": "<their prompt>",
  "max_new_tokens": 512,
  "batch_size": 1,
  "kv_prefetch": false
}
```
That should avoid the large transient GPU allocation path.

Kevin S: I'll collect node metrics now. Preliminary `kubectl top` from node gpu-07 shows GPU memory pinned at 100% for the culprit pods right before the restart. Also seeing 3 restarts in 7m for inference-runner on those pods. I'll upload the core dumps to our S3 bucket.

support-automation: Created internal ticket INF-2247 with attached logs and annotated severity P1 -> account exec notified.

Anjali P: Ops mitigation: we should disable prefetch for the model globally until runtime patch lands. I can push a quick feature-flag kill switch to the model config. Also add an eviction threshold so the autoscaler doesn't keep cycling the same node.

ops-bot: NodeEvent: gpu-07 kernel message: GPU watchdog reset detected, pod inference-runner-xx restarted (3x) at 2024-06-18T09:12:15Z.

Maria G: Customer is OK with fallback -> they've accepted routing to gpt-4k for now. They asked for a timeline for the patch and an answer about whether this is a security or data-loss concern.

Ryan L: No data-loss — it's a termination/OOM. Patch ETA: repro confirmed, fix will be a kernel allocation change + add guard for kv_prefetch path — aiming for rollout in canary within 24 hours, full rollout 48 hours after validation. I'll post a PR and link.

Kevin S: Postmortem checklist: capture core dumps, container logs, kubeevents, and the exact input that triggered repro. Maria, can you ask Acme to share a sanitized prompt and the full request payload for a failing call id (call_8c9a)?

Maria G: Asked for sanitized payload now. They sent back a truncated example; forwarding in support ticket.

Sreeva N: I'll implement the routing override and the temporary rate limit. Assigning owners: runtime eng (Ryan) for fix, SRE (Kevin) for postmortem + cluster mitigations, Infra (Anjali) for model config kill switch, Support (Maria) owns customer comms.

Kevin S: Noting follow-ups: add a regression test in CI for int8 + kv_prefetch + long new tokens; add a metric that counts worker OOMs per model variant.

Maria G: Thanks team — I'll update the customer that we're routing them to gpt-4k and provide the short-term payload recommendations. Will keep this thread updated as we see core dump analysis or the PR link. :white_check_mark:

Ryan L: PR created: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/891 — includes guard and unit tests. Kickoff canary now.

ops-bot: DeployBot: rollout started for runtime-canary to pool=hosted-infer-canary at 2024-06-18T10:02:09Z.

Kevin S: Canary observed for 2h with no reproductions so far. Will approve staged rollout tomorrow if metrics stay green.

support-automation: Ticket INF-2247 updated: customer notified, routing override in place, patch in canary.

Maria G: Closing loop with Acme — they reported decreased 503s after routing to gpt-4k and following guidance. Leaving thread open for PMR and postmortem. :+1:
